# Project / Module Name

One-paragraph description of what this project or module does and who it is for.

## Prerequisites

- Node (version pinned in `.nvmrc` / `.node-version`)
- Expo CLI and an iOS Simulator (macOS) or Android Emulator for device testing

## Install

```bash
npm install
```

## Usage

```bash
npm start          # start the Expo dev server
npm run ios        # run on an iOS simulator
npm run android    # run on an Android emulator
```

## Scripts

Document the npm scripts a contributor will use day to day (lint, test, check,
etc.). Link to the root README's script table rather than duplicating it.

## Testing

```bash
npm test
npm run test:coverage
```

## Contributing

Branching model (Git Flow), commit convention (Conventional Commits), and the local
quality gate (`npm run check` before push, `npm run check:all` for the full gate).
